dict.string: Helix Harness uses the microphone you select for local voice dictation.
Helix Harness uses Automation to open Terminal and run coding-workspace commands you approve.
Helix Harness needs Desktop access so the terminal and coding tools can work in project folders you keep there.
Helix Harness needs Documents access so the terminal and coding tools can work in project folders you keep there.
Helix Harness needs Downloads access so the terminal and coding tools can read and write files you place there.
Helix Harness needs removable-volume access when a coding workspace lives on an external disk.
Helix Harness needs network-volume access when a coding workspace lives on a mounted share.
